title: What The Piano Knows — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal music philosophy Spanish French language learning
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The piano has eighty-eight keys and that should be enough
But Beethoven thought otherwise and made things very rough
He wrote for a piano that hadn't been invented yet
Which is either genius or a scheduling problem — I haven't decided yet

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
El piano tiene ochenta y ocho teclas — debería bastar
[The piano has eighty-eight keys — that should be enough]
Pero Beethoven pensó distinto y quiso más crear
[But Beethoven thought otherwise and wanted to create more]
Escribió para un piano que todavía no existía
[He wrote for a piano that did not yet exist]
O era un genio o tenía problemas de agenda propia
[Either he was a genius or he had scheduling problems of his own]

[Chorus — English]
What does the piano know that I don't know?
It knows that eighty-eight positions cover everything we feel below
What does the piano know when nobody's playing it?
It knows the next note before the hand has even started it
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Le piano a quatre-vingt-huit touches — cela devrait suffire
[The piano has eighty-eight keys — that should be enough]
Mais Beethoven ne pensait pas ainsi — il a voulu aller plus loin
[But Beethoven didn't think so — he wanted to go further]
Il a écrit pour un piano qui n'existait pas encore
[He wrote for a piano that did not yet exist]
Le piano sait tout ce que le compositeur ignore encore
[The piano knows everything the composer still ignores]

[Outro — All three languages]
What the piano knows… Lo que sabe el piano… Ce que sait le piano
Eighty-eight positions, everything — Ochenta y ocho posiciones, todo — Quatre-vingt-huit positions, tout
That's my boy
